faq_heading: Westwood Plateau condos and townhomes: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Westwood Plateau, Coquitlam: 47 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 7 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 23 Coquitlam communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau fell from 53 in June to 47 in September, and 35 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.8% of Coquitlam’s 806 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Westwood Plateau?
Westwood Plateau also had 67 houses listed and 10 sold in September, against 47 condos and townhomes listed. The Westwood Plateau houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Westwood Plateau?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 47 condos and townhomes listed in Westwood Plateau. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Westwood Plateau a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Westwood Plateau had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 35 condos and townhomes sold in Westwood Plateau over those 4 months, out of 475 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
